messages:
Alex: Quick sync — operator UX for autofallback. TL;DR: we need a simple 'why did we fallback' path in the operator inbox, plus a lightweight re-run button. Thoughts?

Maria: +1. Main ask: make the explanation actionable. Right now it's just an error code. Need: error class, confidence, and 'suggested followups' (retry, route to cheaper model, escalate).

Sam: Agree. Also add link to trace and last request payload. For privacy, strip PII. Maybe show a token sample instead of raw text.

OpsBot: (deploy) Canary rollout enabled for policy v2.3 — 10% routes.

Alex: For UI, propose a 3-line collapsed card per fallback event: 1) reason + rule name; 2) telemetry snapshot (latency, err rate, model variant); 3) operator actions (retry, pin override, create incident). Minimal clicks.

Jon: UX nit: make 'retry' async with a small toast and show whether retry would consume quota. We must surface quota burn estimate before operator confirms.

Maria: Telemetry: we should add labels: "fallback_trigger", "fallback_confidence", and "fallback_score" to traces. Also a sampling flag so we don't index everything.

Sam: Sampling proposal: deterministic sample by route hash at 1% default, escalate to 100% capture for routes flagged as critical, and full-capture on operator 'inspect'.

Todd: API debate: should the SDK expose an operator-ack endpoint or reuse the rollout API? I prefer a separate /operator/ack to decouple audit-ack from rollout config.

Alex: Good point. Separate endpoint keeps semantics clear (ack vs config change). Also makes audit trails easier.

Maria: RBAC: override button must require ops:can_override. Also log the operator id in the audit entry.

Sam: I'll prototype a sampling hook that flips to full for a request if operator clicked inspect within 5m. Keeps ingestion low but enables replay.

Jon: Mockup idea: small chevron to expand details, and an inline link "Open trace" that opens a side panel — no new tab.

Alex: Action items: Todd -> draft /operator/ack spec; Maria -> add telemetry labels to trace schema; Sam -> prototype sampling hook; Jon -> mock minimal operator inbox UI; Alex -> stub PR with UI + API proto. Sync Friday 10am. :thumbsup:

Maria: Tiny extra: include a small 'why sensitive' blurb when we strip payload (for audits).

Sam: I'll add a CLI flag to force full-capture during replay tests (for e2e).

Alex: Thanks all. If no objections I'll open the PR tomorrow morning.
thread_snapshot: short discussion, operator UX + telemetry + API ack endpoint, sampling strategy, RBAC and action items
